title: A user without Reports access still cannot open Sales By Representative
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in at the test location as user B, whose role does not have "Reports — Page Access".
  • Have the address of the Sales By Representative report, copied from the browser's address bar while signed in as an Admin.
  • Open any page in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Look for Reports > Sales By Representative.
  2. Paste that address into the browser's address bar and open it.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report is not offered.

Step 2:

  • The report does not open for user B.
  • Neither the screen nor its exports are available.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • Story 5 prerequisites: “User has 'Reports — Page Access' enabled. It governs the Sales By Representative report on screen and its exports.”
